title: Screen a validation-only count pass for counted Balanced
question: Does avoiding first-pass packed rows materially improve complete native counted singleton Balanced under a hard memory limit?
summary: Median job time fell 3.41% and CPU fell 5.65%, below the predeclared 5% elapsed and 10% CPU rules. All pairs improved and memory and managed spill costs were effectively unchanged.

workloads: 8 GiB plain four-column CSV, eight exact parts, hard 1 GiB cgroup without swap, 256 MiB engine memory and one worker.

validation.summary: Three exact-output pairs, focused parser parity and intake admission/terminal tests, 35 native direct-run tests in each arm, and portable-core WASM compile.

limitations: WSL2/ext4, uncontrolled backing cache, single fixture and one worker.
The parser validation cost is shared; the candidate removed packed field copies only. The earlier hot raw-proof component is a separate experiment.
exclusions: Excluded small preflight pair and full warmup pair. Fixture hashing and independent oracle run outside timer.
reopen_when: Revisit for a job where first-pass record construction produces material CPU or working memory cost, supported by profiling or a relevant contract change.
